color.worst_reason: Brand orange CTAs, badges, and accent colors closely match the reference, though product card backgrounds in the agent version use varied pastel tints instead of neutral grey.

typography.worst_reason: Heading sizes, weights, and label styling appear very similar with consistent hierarchy across both versions.

assets.worst_reason: The agent version shows broken image placeholders (boxes with question marks) for the phone, product thumbnails, and related items instead of actual product images.

proportion.worst_reason: Overall layout proportions match well, but quantity stepper controls are missing the +/- buttons and some spacing differs slightly in cart items.

states.worst_reason: Active pills, checked checkboxes, and filled CTA states are preserved, though the 'Со скидкой' and 'Доставка завтра' pills appear as outlined rather than filled like in the reference.

cart.explanation: The score is held back primarily by missing product images and icons throughout (showing question mark placeholders instead of actual assets) and severely mismatched text content in key sections including the top navigation, footer, and guarantees (all 0.00 F1), along with weak category nav, breadcrumbs, cart tabs, cart items, and sidebar copy.

catalog.explanation: The score is held back primarily by broken product image assets rendered as placeholder boxes instead of the phone illustrations, and by near-zero text content matches across the top navigation, category nav, breadcrumb title, brand tabs, and sort filters.

home.explanation: The two biggest failures are widespread missing assets (product images, category icons, and the QR code rendering as placeholder boxes with question marks) and severe textual content gaps across key sections including top_nav, category_nav, hero_banners, and footer all scoring 0.00.

product.explanation: The score is held back primarily by broken image assets (placeholder boxes instead of real product photos) and severely mismatched text content in the top navigation, breadcrumbs, product hero, product options, and seller info sections (F1 ≤ 0.21).

seller.explanation: The score is held down by missing/placeholder product imagery and the map pin (assets scored 2/5) and by widespread text content mismatches across nearly every section (top_nav, tabs, ratings, promo_banner, categories_filter, pagination, contact_info, and footer all scoring 0.00–0.17).
